mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) and weak retail sales (RSAFS < 400 million) signal deteriorating consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0% AND RSAFS < 400), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (INDPRO > 95 and UNRATE < 4.0%), overvaluation and expected monetary tightening cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 95 and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO relative to previous month) signals manufacturing weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO declines (current < prior), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal broad economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO and HOUST both decline (current < prior), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 750 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 750, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
